signature_metadata_schema.public_key_encoding: base64 / hex (raw ML-DSA-65 public key, 1952 bytes)

canonical_payload_hashing.canonicalization: deterministic canonical JSON of the ProofRecord with signature fields excluded
canonical_payload_hashing.digest: SHA-256 of the canonical payload bytes
canonical_payload_hashing.signed_message_form: aws-kms-native custody signs the SHA-256 digest (KMS RAW ML-DSA message cap); software custody signs the canonical payload bytes directly

rotation_retirement_revocation.rotation: non-destructive; retired keys remain published for historical verification
rotation_retirement_revocation.retirement: retired public keys stay discoverable via this manifest and the pq-public-key endpoint
rotation_retirement_revocation.revocation: revoked flag exposed per retired key (revoked=true means do not trust for new verification)

verification_guidance: Verify ProofRecords with any FIPS 204 ML-DSA-65 implementation over the deterministic canonical-JSON payload (signature fields excluded). Resolve the public key by public_key_id/key_version; try the SHA-256 digest form first (aws-kms-native) then the raw canonical-payload form.
